The Miele Guard L1 Cat & Dog is a bagged canister vacuum expertly designed for pet owners. Its German-engineered motor delivers powerful suction for effective multi-surface cleaning. The AllTeQ universal floorhead lets you glide from hard floors to low-pile carpets using the convenient footswitch, while the TurboTeQ floorhead thoroughly cleans pet hair from low-medium pile carpet. Hygiene is paramount with the integrated Active AirClean Filter, featuring active charcoal to neutralize those persistent pet odors. The HyClean Air TU vacuum bags, crafted with 80% recycled material and ComfortFit technology, ensure dust-free disposal. User-friendly features include foot-controlled suction power settings, a height-adjustable telescopic wand, and a Comfort handle with an integrated dusting brush. You'll also find a handy 2-in-1 Upholstery & Crevice Nozzle, a practical Parking System, and a generous 36 ft. operating radius for fewer interruptions during cleaning. This model includes the following: TurboTeQ floorhead, AllTeQ Universal floorhead, integrated Active AirClean Filter and vacuum bag, 2-in-1 Upholstery & Crevice Nozzle, and Dusting Brush in Handle. Please note, this vacuum is not compatible with Miele electric floorheads or accessories.
